preflight._comment: GPU node-health, IFoE scale-up fabric, and optional RDMA preflight validation

node_check._comment: Generation-independent node validation performed in parallel across nodes
node_check._comment_enabled: Enable GPU visibility, AMDGPU/KFD, kernel-health, and ROCm validation.
node_check._comment_gpus_per_node: Exact number of AMD GPUs expected on every node.
node_check._comment_expected_rocm_version: Expected ROCm version across all cluster nodes. Replace <changeme> with the output reported by amd-smi.

connectivity_check._comment: Inter-node connectivity tests grouped by protocol

rdma._comment: RDMA inventory and ibv_rc_pingpong connectivity settings
rdma._comment_connectivity_mode: RDMA mode: basic, full_mesh, or skip. Skip disables RDMA interface, GID, and pairwise checks.
rdma._comment_gid_index: GID index checked on every configured RDMA interface, typically 3 for RoCE.
rdma._comment_interfaces: RDMA device names expected on every node. These replace the deprecated node_check.rdma_interfaces path.
rdma._comment_nodes_per_full_mesh_group: Nodes per full-mesh partition group. Smaller groups reduce per-node resource use but require more rounds.
rdma._comment_ibv_test_timeout: Timeout in seconds for each ibv_rc_pingpong connectivity test.
rdma._comment_ibv_test_port_range: TCP coordination port range for ibv_rc_pingpong tests, formatted as start-end.
rdma._comment_inter_full_mesh_group_pairs_per: Maximum ordered group pairs per inter-group wave. Auto derives a safe value from the group count.
rdma._comment_prune_failure_threshold: Exclude a node from inter-group testing when its intra-group peer failure fraction reaches this threshold.
rdma._comment_port_retry_max: Additional batches attempted for PORT_LISTEN_FAILED pairs using newly assigned ports.
rdma._comment_port_retry_gap: Gap above the previous maximum port when assigning ports for retries.
rdma._comment_exclude_failed_interface_nodes: Legacy reporting hint. Interface- or GID-failed nodes are excluded from the RDMA mesh regardless of this value.

ifoe._comment: MI4XX IFoE scale-up fabric admission and data-path checks
ifoe._comment_fabric_checks: Add AIFM/AFM/vPOD, station-mask, and IFoE port admission to node health.
ifoe._comment_policy: CVS owns afmctl discovery, privilege handling, BDF and port discovery, strict coverage, traffic selection, and timeout derivation.

l2ping._comment: Strict afmctl L2 connectivity gate executed before TransferBench and RDMA
l2ping._comment_pings_per_port: Ping samples sent per selected IFoE port pair.

transferbench._comment: TransferBench IFoE data-path validation executed before RDMA
transferbench._comment_scope: Run independent tests per node or one multi-rank cluster test. Options: node, cluster.
transferbench._comment_profile: CVS-supported TransferBench validation profile. Currently: smoketest.
transferbench._comment_message_sizes: Message sizes exercised by the selected profile.
transferbench._comment_iterations: Validated iterations per test and message size.

reporting._comment_generate_html_report: Generate the detailed HTML preflight report.
reporting._comment_artifacts_root_dir: Root directory for reports and RDMA full-mesh ScriptLet workspaces.
reporting._comment_generate_rdma_pairs_csv: Write a CSV containing failed RDMA pairs beside the HTML report.

debug._comment_scriptlet: Preserve RDMA ScriptLet artifacts and enable detailed server tracing. This can be expensive at scale.
